## Old query and replacement
- **Old:** `@container (min-width: 720px)` with no container name. It was unnamed and matched the nearest ancestor container, which is `.shell`, set by `.shell { container-type: inline-size; }`. It styled `.shell__body`.
- **Old breakpoint:** 720px, the same as the one you specified.
- **New:** `@media (min-width: 720px)`. The rules inside (`display: grid; grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr; padding: 24px`) are unchanged.

## `container-type`
I removed it. The `.shell` rule contained only that one property, so I deleted the whole rule. I searched the repo for `@container`, `container-type`, `container-name`, `container:` and `inline-size`. The only `@container` rule was the one I replaced, so nothing else depended on it and there was no container name to look for.

- **`§container-not-viewport` anchor:** nothing else references it. I kept the anchor name and changed only the description to say it was overridden.
